content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

While Gumroad provides a simple way to sell digital products, its 10% transaction fee can quickly add up. PayPal and Stripe, on the other hand, come with their own set of restrictions, limiting sellers in certain countries from using their services. NOWPayments, however, offers a much lower transaction fee of 0.5%, making it an attractive alternative for creators who want to keep more of their earnings. Additionally, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, giving sellers the flexibility to accept payments in various currencies.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad, PayPal, and Stripe all have their own set of restrictions when it comes to certain countries. Sellers in these countries may find themselves locked out of using these popular platforms. In contrast, NOWPayments has no restrictions on countries, making it a great option for creators who need to sell digital products to a global audience. By using NOWPayments, sellers can avoid the frustration of being blocked by payment gateways and maintain their freedom to sell their products worldwide.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The payment speed and fees associated with each option can have a significant impact on the profitability of a digital product. Gumroad's 10% transaction fee may seem reasonable at first, but it can add up quickly. With NOWPayments, the 0.5% transaction fee may seem more appealing, but it's essential to consider the real costs involved. For example, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments would retain $921. This is a significant amount of money that can make or break a business.
A sovereign digital commerce stack is the key to breaking free from platform fees and maintaining full ownership over your digital products.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to owning and delivering digital products, the architecture of a digital commerce stack can make all the difference. With Gumroad, sellers have limited control over their products and are subject to the platform's terms and conditions. NOWPayments, on the other hand, allows sellers to maintain full ownership over their digital products and automate the delivery process using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This means that sellers can focus on creating and marketing their products, while the infrastructure takes care of the delivery and payment processing.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Ultimately, the choice of architecture depends on the specific needs and goals of the digital creator. If you're looking for a simple and easy-to-use solution, Gumroad may be a good option. However, if you're looking to break free from platform fees and maintain full ownership over your digital products, NOWPayments is the way to go. By considering your options carefully and choosing the right architecture for your situation, you can ensure that your digital commerce stack is robust, scalable, and profitable.
